reviews.review:
A great modern Third Person Shooter.
Think of the Gears Of War games but with more enphasis in melee combat and less covering behind walls.
It has excellent controls and solid shooting, a good variety of weapons, amazing art direction and an incredible soundtrack.
One thing I liked is that this game doesn't have regenerative health. Instead, if you nned to heal yourself, you have to stun an enemy an perform a takedown (think of Doom 2016). The catch is that, for the takedown animation, other enemies don't wait patiently for you to finish it, so if you have really low health and are surrounded by orks while doing it, you'll end up dead. This makes you think who to stun, who to separate from the crowd and when to do it.
The problems I had with this game is that the arenas/levels, while distinct visually, gameplay wise they feel the same. And this gives you a feeling of repetitiveness after a while. The same can be said about enemy variety. There are lots of different enemies but they all feel similar, or that they belong in a set group: you have cannon fodder, melee rushers, gunners, grenadiers and thats it. If the game introduces a new faction, you can confidently assume that this new enemy belongs to one of said groups.
Something that I would have liked is the ability to play the campaign in co-op. As single player is fine, but again, you feel like doing the same thing over and over instead of playing with a buddy and providing covering fire or flanking enemies.
Anyway, this is still a fantastic game and I highly recommend it to those looking for a fun action game and a friendly entry to the Warhammer lore.

4/5
Despite its age being an obvious factor, this game still offers a very fun playthrough and some solid context of the 40k universe to the player.

Love this game - played it to death on PS3.
It's the most 40k experience you can get.
Buy it or be judged for heresy.
I played the game after Space Marine 2 and I consider that it is still a solid game. It might be quite old, it's not without flaws but it was fun to play. Recommended.
